verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own payout-schedule control: payout frequency is configurable per merchant account, and you can choose when and in which currency to settle. The reconciliation half is only thinly covered: reporting offers a visual view of balances, sales, and payouts, but nothing shows a per-payout breakdown of the charges, fees, and refunds behind each payout. missing for 10: documented per-payout composition of charges, fees, and refunds (e.g. settlement detail reports), payout-level reconciliation via API or export, independent or hands-on corroboration.
